title: Ashen
statusNote: Logos, menus, the story pages and the 3D opening cutscene all run, and Chapter 1 (Seven River City) plays: moving, looking, jumping, shooting and reloading work. Some of the menu and story lettering is drawn with pixels missing but stays readable.
notes: A new game opens with story pages and a cutscene that run on their own for a minute or two before the first level starts; OK turns the story pages sooner.
Either soft key pauses (Continue, Restart, Options, Quit). 0 shows the current objectives; press 0 again to close them.
The game can remap its keys under Options > Controls > Controller Type > User Defined. That changes which N-Gage key an action uses, on top of the bindings here.
Multiplayer needs Bluetooth, and N-Gage Arena is no longer online; neither is available here.

controls.source: The game's defaults, read from Options > Controls > Controller Type > User Defined and each confirmed in play, except Ghost Vision and the two weapon keys, which showed no effect at the very start of Chapter 1. Pause and objectives (soft keys, 0) observed in play.
notes: First-person layout: move and strafe on WASD, turn on the arrows or Q/E, look up and down on Page Up/Page Down or T/G. F fires, Space jumps, R reloads, V is Ghost Vision, [ and ] change weapon, Tab shows the objectives. On a gamepad the left stick moves and turns, the right stick strafes and looks, and the right trigger fires.

enhance.note: The level's faces with textures and light maps, liquids and moving parts (doors, lifts) are captured; the sky, the weapon and the status bar are left to the game. Models were never on screen in the scenes tried. Needs the emulator's paletteStride.
